stem: Which event from the story shows that Bragger's attitude about playing basketball is different from Kirby's?

options.label: F
options.text: Bragger picking up the ball after Kirby misses a basket

options.label: G
options.text: Bragger claiming not to know several basic basketball facts

options.label: H

options.label: J
